annotations.title: Recover an operation after response loss

description: Recover one action's durable operation using its original idempotency_key. Authenticated actions require the original key; anonymous client keys act as secret, expiring receipt capabilities. No charges, writes, cross-account enumeration, or automatic retries.

action.description: Exact action name whose operation receipt to recover.

idempotency_key.description: Original idempotency key used for this action; retain it across retries.

receipt_handle.description: Secret receipt capability returned by an anonymous action; required when no authenticated owner key is available.

name: koskamo_find_operations
